Name: Isla Reimagined Redux
Author: MarsCBG
Description:
[size=3]This mod is an update (with permission) to the old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8720]Isla Reimagined[/url] mod which is now broken due to updates to Isla.

Now has diverse options! Edits to Elysa's diverse portraits were made using edited assets from [size=3][size=3]Jaz and Poltergeister[/size][/size]'s [size=3][size=3][url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url][/size][/size].

From the original mod description:

A complete set of sprites and portraits for PaperNautilus' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6931]Custom NPC Isla[/url]﻿. The new looks are a bit different from the original vision, but I've tried my best to make them fit her personality, and, as of 2.0, kept the green hair and seashell hairpin. The seasonal outfits are purposefully  more varied than the original, also in hopes to better fit in with recommended mods. The sprites and portraits are quite detailed, and (I believe) fit in well with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod by Poltergeister.﻿

The sprites and portraits, however, where made from scratch, with the exception of Elysa and Soraya's portraits, which were made by editing Camila and Clare's portraits from [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] by Poltergeister  (and a flower used in the summer outdoor portrait, also by Poltergeister).[/size]

[b][size=3]﻿Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6931]original Isla mod[/url];﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download and install the main files from this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Credits[/b]:
[list]
[*][size=3][b]PaperNautilus[/b] for the original Isla - Custom NPC mod[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Poltergeister, Ailin, and Tanpoponoko[/b] for Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE and it's Camilla and Claire portraits, the bases for Elysa and Soraya's. Also for the flower used in Isla's hat in her summer outdoor portrait.[/size]
[/list]
[b]Additional Credits[/b]:
[list]
[*][size=3][b]AEscraed[/b] for the original mod that this is an update for.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Jaz and Poltergeister [/b]for [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url]﻿ from which I edited some assets for Elysa's diverse portraits.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
[/size]
